## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 13 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Wednesday, September 2, 2026. The audience already understands AEM Resources, dialogs, HTL, client libraries and browser evidence. This class connects a project-owned Guide Card proxy to a versioned Core Component implementation and its observable Adobe Client Data Layer contract.",
    "core_claim": "A safe AEM customization gives the project a stable proxy resource type, delegates to a versioned Core Component, changes only the narrowest necessary extension point and preserves observable runtime contracts.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "Core Components package authoring dialogs, Sling Models, HTL markup, accessibility and client-side behavior as reusable production capabilities.",
      "Public Core Component versions protect existing sites from incompatible implementation changes.",
      "Content should reference a site-specific sling:resourceType rather than a Core Component path directly.",
      "A project proxy owns the author-facing title, component group and policy surface.",
      "sling:resourceSuperType delegates missing scripts and resources to an explicit versioned Core Component parent.",
      "A fully inherited proxy can be almost empty and should not copy product implementation.",
      "Customization options increase in maintenance cost from policy/style through dialog, scoped assets, model delegation and HTL override.",
      "Changing a component super type version is a contract change that can affect authoring, models, markup, CSS hooks, client behavior and Data Layer output.",
      "Core Components integrate with the Adobe Client Data Layer to expose standardized component data and events when enabled.",
      "A proxy customization should preserve inherited identifiers, semantic markup, accessibility, supported Data Layer values and browser-observable behavior unless a requirement deliberately changes them."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Core Components",
      "proxy component",
      "sling:resourceType",
      "sling:resourceSuperType",
      "/apps/wknd/components/guide-card",
      "core/wcm/components/teaser/v2/teaser",
      "Style System",
      "Sling Model delegation",
      "HTL override",
      "Adobe Client Data Layer",
      "data-cmp-data-layer",
      "adobeDataLayer"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "Show one Core Component capability capsule exposing five production surfaces: authoring dialog, Sling Model, HTL markup, accessibility and client behavior. Place an inspection gate before custom code: installed version, documented feature and rendered contract. Do not imply that every Core Component supports every feature."
  }
}
